meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission heard Marshall Park phasing update; cost decision on phases set for the Feb 19 meeting.
Parks Commission voted to take all of Marshall Park phases 1, 2A and 2B to Town Meeting, plus OPM costs, as a debt exclusion.

votes.motion: Approve LYSA's conditional use of the outfield of the 90 foot diamond or any other suitable field.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion conditionally to approve lysa to use the outﬁeld of the 90 foot diamond or any other ﬁeld that is suitable. c. shapiro seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the $40,000 budget for the revolving fund.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to approve the $40,000 budget for the revolving fund. c. shapiro seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the design and construction oversight for Marshall Park phases 1, 2A and 2B, with construction and general conditions cost of $13,080,797 plus additional Skanska expenses.
votes.quote: c. shapiro made a motion to vote to approve the design and do the construction oversight of the construction for phases 1, 2a and 2b for the marshall park improvements

votes.motion: Approve RDLA invoice #24555-05 for 1/1-1/31/2025 in the amount of $29,737.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to approve. c. shapiro seconded. the chair called for a vote. all in favor, motion carried (4-0).
t. lawless made a motion to approve the minutes for november 6, 2024. c. sullivan seconded. the chair called for a vote. all in favor, motion carried (4-0).
c. shapiro made a motion to approve the minutes for december 18, 2024. c. sullivan seconded. the chair called for a vote. all in favor, motion carried (4-0).

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission set two April public sessions on Marshall Park borrowing and reviewed plans for the spring fair.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of January 15, 2025 and February 19, 2025 as amended.
votes.quote: c. sullivan motioned and k. menard seconded to a prove the minutes of january 15, 2025 and february 19, 2025 as amended. vote 5-0.
t. lawless motioned and k. menard seconded to adjourn at 8:28pm. vote 5-0.

votes.motion: Approve a donation of money to buy new park benches or the materials to repair the existing benches at Veterans Memorial Park.
votes.quote: c. shapiro motioned to approve the donation of money to buy new park benches or the materials to repair the existing benches at veterans memorial park. t. lawless seconded. passed 5-0
c. sullivan motioned to adjourn at 7:55pm. c. shapiro seconded. passed 5-0
c. sullivan motioned to adjourn at 10:45am. k. menard seconded. passed 4-0

meetings.ours_headline: Commission leans toward a scaled-back Marshall Park plan for fall town meeting after spring's defeat

votes.motion: Nominate Karin Menard as Chair of the Park Commission, effective immediately.
votes.quote: c. shapiro moved to nominate karin menard as the chair of the park commission effective immediately.

votes.motion: Nominate Chris Sullivan as Vice-Chair of the Park Commission, effective immediately.
votes.quote: k. menard moved to nominate chris sullivan as the vice-chair of the park commission effective immediately.

votes.motion: Allocate $3,050.72 for the proposed equipment to repair the swing and the merry-go-round at Wallace Park.
votes.quote: a. scheipers moved to allocate $3,050.72 for the proposed equipment to repair the swing and the merry-go-round at wallace park.

votes.motion: Appoint Colleen Shapiro as the Park Commission representative to the Open Space Committee, effective immediately.
votes.quote: k. menard moved to appoint colleen shapiro as the park commission representative for the open space committee, effective immediately.
c. sullivan moved to adjourn. seconded by c. shapiro. call for the vote: five-aye. the motion passed unanimously (5-0-0).

meetings.ours_headline: Commission will keep funding Marshall Park design but delay the next town-meeting vote about a year

votes.motion: Approve the amended minutes of March 26, 2025, April 9, 2025, April 26, 2025, and June 4, 2025.
votes.quote: a. scheipers moved to approve march 26, 2025, april 9, 2025, april 26, 2025, and june 4, 2025, amended minutes. seconded by c. sullivan.
a. scheipers moved to adjourn. seconded by c. sullivan. call for the vote: three-aye. the motion passed unanimously (3-0-0).

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission voted a $50 fine against a resident for repeated unleashed dogs at McNiff Park despite an ADA claim
Parks Commission held off deciding the skate park bond amount, deferring to Chris Ruth's review first

votes.quote: c. shapiro motioned and c. sullivan seconded to adorn at 3:59pm.

meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission tables the roughly $14 million Marshall Park project until town finances are clearer.
